# link11waap_flow_control_policy (Resource)

Manages a Flow Control Policy in Link11 WAAP.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Flow Control Policy Resource

data "link11waap_config" "main" {}

resource "link11waap_flow_control_policy" "checkout_flow" {
  config_id   = data.link11waap_config.main.id
  name        = "Example Flow Control Policy"
  description = "Enforce a specific request flow for checkout process"

  # Whether the flow control policy is active
  active = true

  # Time window in seconds within which the flow steps must be completed
  timeframe = 60

  # Optional: tags to apply to matching requests
  # tags = ["checkout"]

  # Optional: tags describing requests to include / exclude
  include = ["all"]
  exclude = ["internal:devops-ci-cd"]

  # Flow control key configuration.
  # At least one key block is required.
  # Exactly one of attrs, args, plugins, cookies, or headers must be set per block.
  key {
    attrs = "session"
  }
  key {
    args = "flow_id"
  }
  key {
      plugins = "abcd.efgh.ijkl"
  }
  key {
      cookies = "session_id"
  }
  key {
      headers = "X-Test-Header"
  }


  # Ordered steps describing the restricted request flow.
  # At least one step is required; steps must be completed in order within the timeframe.
  steps {
    method = "GET"
    uri    = "/cart"
    headers = {
      "Host" = "shop.example.com"
    }
  }

  steps {
    method = "POST"
    uri    = "/checkout"

    # Optional: header/cookie/arg/plugin name-value pairs required at this step
    headers = {
      "X-Requested-With" = "XMLHttpRequest"
    }
    args    = {
      "test" = "value"
    }
    cookies = {
        "my_cookie" = "123456"
    }
  }
  steps {
    method = "GET"
    uri    = "/"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the flow control policy is active.
- `config_id` (String) The configuration ID.
- `name` (String) The name of the flow control policy.
- `timeframe` (Number) Time window in seconds within which the flow steps must be completed.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the flow control policy.
- `exclude` (List of String) Tags describing requests to exclude from the flow control policy.
- `include` (List of String) Tags describing requests to include in the flow control policy.
- `key` (Block List) Flow control key configuration. At least one block is required. Exactly one of attrs, args, plugins, cookies, or headers must be set per block. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--key))
- `steps` (Block List) Ordered steps describing the restricted request flow. At least one step is required. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--steps))
- `tags` (List of String) List of tags to apply to matching requests.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the flow control policy.

<a id="nestedblock--key"></a>
### Nested Schema for `key`

Optional:

- `args` (String) Flow control by query argument name.
- `attrs` (String) Flow control by request attribute.
- `cookies` (String) Flow control by cookie name.
- `headers` (String) Flow control by header name.
- `plugins` (String) Flow control by plugin data.


<a id="nestedblock--steps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `steps`

Required:

- `method` (String) HTTP method for this step.
- `uri` (String) URI path for this step.

Optional:

- `args` (Map of String) Query argument name/value pairs.
- `cookies` (Map of String) Cookie name/value pairs.
- `headers` (Map of String) Header name/value pairs required at this step.
- `plugins` (Map of String) Plugin key/value pairs.
